# `comparison_figure.py` reference PNGs — rendered unit-test fixtures, not documentation

**These two PNGs are literal renders of `tests/test_comparison_figure.py`'s own toy unit-test
fixtures — not a curated illustrative example, and not real corpus data.** They live under
`tests/fixtures/` rather than `docs/` specifically because of that: the numbers were chosen so a
`pytest` assertion could tell coarse apart from fine, not to look like a plausible result. Read
them as "proof `comparison_figure.py`'s plotting code runs and produces a real image," not as
"here is what a coarse-vs-fine comparison looks like." The eventual real-data version of
`coarse_vs_fine_comparison.png`/`diagnostic_config_mean_collapse.png` — generated once
`examples/prelim_sweep_fine/surrogate/` exists (see below) — belongs in `docs/visualization/`
instead, mirroring `examples/prelim_sweep/figures/evidence_figure.png`'s existing convention for
genuine evidence figures; nothing under that path today, since that figure doesn't exist yet.

- `coarse_vs_fine_comparison.png` — generated by
  `mosquito_cfd.force_surrogate.comparison_figure.build_coarse_vs_fine_comparison` from
  `inputs/coarse_predictions.parquet` / `inputs/fine_predictions.parquet`, the exact
  fixture used by `tests/test_comparison_figure.py::test_coarse_vs_fine_panel_means_match_groupby`.
- `diagnostic_config_mean_collapse.png` — generated by
  `build_config_mean_collapse_diagnostic` from `inputs/diagnostic_{coarse,fine}_predictions.parquet`
  and `inputs/{coarse,fine}_metrics.json`, the exact fixture used by
  `tests/test_comparison_figure.py::test_config_mean_collapse_diagnostic_matches_metrics_json`.
  The two "per-config mean" panels look identical by design — the fixture varies the
  `config_resolved.CF_x.config_mean_r2` value between the coarse (`0.944`) and fine (`-31.95`)
  `metrics.json` files, not the plotted predictions. That R² collapse is only visible in
  `diagnostic_config_mean_collapse_metrics.json`, not in the PNG itself — the same
  "waveform fit looks fine, R² has collapsed" gap this diagnostic exists to catch.

Each PNG's `*_metrics.json`/`*_run_metadata.json` siblings are real outputs of the CC-1
run-metadata sidecar mechanism (git commit, hardware, timestamp) exercised against the synthetic
inputs above — they are not evidence of any real simulation or CFD run. `docker_image` is a
placeholder digest (`sha256:` + repeated `a`). Each `*_run_metadata.json` also carries a
top-level `"synthetic": true` marker (added after generation, since
`capture_surrogate_run_metadata`'s `extra` fields are internal to library callers, not
CLI-exposed) so the disclosure travels with the JSON itself, not only this README — the real
git commit/hostname/GPU alongside a placeholder digest could otherwise be mistaken for a real
captured run by anyone reading just the sidecar.

`inputs/` holds the tiny synthetic parquet/JSON inputs so the PNGs and `*_metrics.json`
outputs are regenerable byte-for-byte via the commands below, without reading test source. The
`*_run_metadata.json` sidecars will **not** come back byte-identical: `run_id` is a fresh random
UUID each call, `git.dirty`/`git.diff_hash`/`git.commit` reflect whatever tree/commit you run
from, and running these commands as shown will **not** reproduce the `"synthetic": true` marker
— that key was added to the two committed sidecars by a one-off manual post-processing step (not
a committed script, since `capture_surrogate_run_metadata`'s `extra` fields are internal to
library callers, not CLI-exposed), applied once after generation, not something either the CLI
or the library writes on its own.

```bash
uv run python scripts/make_comparison_figure.py \
    --coarse-predictions tests/fixtures/comparison_figure/inputs/coarse_predictions.parquet \
    --fine-predictions tests/fixtures/comparison_figure/inputs/fine_predictions.parquet \
    --out-dir tests/fixtures/comparison_figure \
    --docker-digest "ghcr.io/talmolab/mosquito-cfd@sha256:$(printf 'a%.0s' {1..64})" \
    --timestamp 2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00

uv run python scripts/make_config_mean_collapse_diagnostic.py \
    --coarse-predictions tests/fixtures/comparison_figure/inputs/diagnostic_coarse_predictions.parquet \
    --fine-predictions tests/fixtures/comparison_figure/inputs/diagnostic_fine_predictions.parquet \
    --coarse-metrics tests/fixtures/comparison_figure/inputs/coarse_metrics.json \
    --fine-metrics tests/fixtures/comparison_figure/inputs/fine_metrics.json \
    --out-dir tests/fixtures/comparison_figure \
    --docker-digest "ghcr.io/talmolab/mosquito-cfd@sha256:$(printf 'a%.0s' {1..64})" \
    --timestamp 2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00
```

## Real-data follow-up (deferred)

Generating the **real** version of these two figures against actual fine-grid holdout data
(`examples/prelim_sweep_fine/surrogate/holdout_predictions.parquet` +
`examples/prelim_sweep_fine/surrogate/metrics.json`, writing to `docs/visualization/` as genuine
evidence — see the top of this file) is deferred — that directory does not exist on `main` yet.
It depends on the corrected fine-grid corpus's cluster run, which is itself gated on
